source_finding: Clover-grass juice UF study reports protein selectivity and strong retention of chlorophyll-binding/photosystem proteins; no total-lipid retention coefficient is reported.
transferability_limit: Protein-bound pigments/proteins are not equivalent to the thermodynamic Lipids pseudo-component.
required_resolution: Identify lipid species/phase and measure feed-retentate-permeate mass balance for the selected membrane.

source_finding: NF pretreatment concentrated dissolved organic nitrogen in a specific finished-water matrix; this does not measure total biodegradable organics.
transferability_limit: GreenHub pool is chemically heterogeneous and has no defined molecular-weight distribution or charge.
required_resolution: Resolve pool identity or measure component-class rejection in clarified grass juice.

source_finding: No direct rejection value for this GreenHub lumped pool was identified in the relevant clover-grass juice UF study.
transferability_limit: Biodegradability label does not determine molecular size, phase, aggregation, or membrane interaction.
required_resolution: Resolve species/phase or obtain a feed-specific membrane mass balance.

source_finding: NF DON study reports matrix-specific organic/inorganic nitrogen separation; it does not characterize the GreenHub component.
transferability_limit: GreenHub OrganicNitrogen is an N-equivalent bookkeeping pseudo-component, not a defined DON mixture.
required_resolution: Map nitrogen to identified dissolved species and measure N in feed, retentate, and permeate.

source_finding: PFAS NF study demonstrates compound- and membrane-dependent rejection mechanisms, including size, charge, and adsorption effects.
transferability_limit: PersistentOrganics is a generic pool and is not confirmed to consist of PFAS; compound-level behavior cannot be averaged into this pool.
required_resolution: Identify persistent compounds and establish their concentration and membrane-specific fate.

source_finding: NF pesticide study found compound- and matrix-dependent rejection and membrane adsorption.
transferability_limit: Pesticide identity, concentration, matrix, and adsorption/desorption history are unspecified.
required_resolution: Identify pesticide species and measure feed-retentate-permeate plus membrane adsorption balance.
